sn29.11-20:1.1: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn29.11-20:1.2: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4
sn29.11-20:2.1: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī ||
sn29.11-20:2.3: Aṇḍajā nāgā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn29.11-20:2.5: Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyan ti || || 6
sn29.11-20:2.18: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn29.11-20:2.19: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
